# PowerPlay v1.2.4 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Made the PowerPlay startup logo foreground transparent so it blends with light, dark, OLED, and custom theme backgrounds.
- Added Aurora, Synthwave, Midnight Gold, and Ocean Depths, bringing the curated theme selection to ten.
- Added distinct primary and secondary accents for the new multicolor themes.
